question: The figure a lab wants, in kJ, is the bench total: an intermediate figure plus 21 kJ from a storage battery. The intermediate figure, in kJ, is the combined energy of motion of 12 identical trolleys minus 2 kJ consumed by the drive motor. Each trolley has a mass of 23 kg. The trolleys' speed in m/s equals the speed at t = 1 s of a pace cart whose position in metres is s(t) = 3t^3 - 3t^2 with t in seconds. What bench total, in kJ, does the lab record?

A cart of mass 79000 grams is driven along a level rail 20 m long. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is 11 more than the largest whole number that divides both 221 and 342 exactly. The force producing that acceleration is supplied partly by a helper spring, which contributes 12 N, and the motor supplies the rest. Seven identical carts are driven in the same way. What total force, in N, do the 7 motors supply?

A pace car's position along a straight, in metres, is s(t) = 3t^3 - 4t^2 with t in seconds. A test sled of mass 153000 grams is given an acceleration in m/s^2 equal to 9 times the pace car's speed at t = 1 s, and the force producing that acceleration is expressed in kN. A rack of 9 identical sleds is driven at once, and a counterweight relieves 3 kN of the rack's combined force. What net force, in kN, does the rack's drive supply?

A rescue drone of mass 40000 grams cruises at a speed in m/s equal to the area under the curve y = 1x^2 + 4x between x = 0 and x = 4. A patrol of 8 identical drones has a combined energy of motion, which the base expresses in kJ. The base subtracts 26 kJ consumed by the launch winch and then a further 22 kJ consumed by the ground station. What net figure, in kJ, does the base record?

A cargo cart of mass 118000 grams is driven along a level dock. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 9x + 18 = 0. Each cart's drive must supply the force producing that acceleration plus 23 N of wheel friction plus 19 N of cable drag. A tug drives 8 identical carts, and the dock runs 5 identical tugs. What total drive force, in N, is supplied?

The figure a lab wants, in J (negative meaning a net loss), is the bench balance: 1 J from a charging coil plus the combined balance of 8 identical racks, each rack holding 6 identical pucks, every puck contributing the same balance. A puck's balance is its energy of motion minus the 18 J drawn from the launcher battery to set it moving. Each puck has a mass of 7 kg and a diameter of 0.2 m. The pucks' speed in m/s is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 3x + 2 = 0. What bench balance, in J, does the lab record?

A courier depot has 9 loading bays and counts the ways of choosing 2 of them for a shuttle route; that count is used as the speed in m/s of a 9000 gram delivery robot. The robot's energy of motion, less 21 J lost to wheel friction, is the net energy per robot. Three identical robots run the route, and their combined net energy is expressed in kJ. The depot then adds 13 kJ for the charging dock's reserve. What figure, in kJ, does the depot record?

A pace car's position along a straight, in metres, is s(t) = 5t^3 + 5t^2 with t in seconds, and its speed at t = 1 s is used as the speed in m/s of a 60000 gram test sled on a track 50 m long. The sled's energy of motion is expressed in kJ. A batch is 6 identical sleds, and 7 kJ held in the launcher spring is added to the batch total. What batch total, in kJ, is recorded?

A stamping press drives rams of mass 81 kg through a stroke of 0.25 m. Each ram's acceleration in m/s^2 equals the area under the curve y = 2x^2 + 1x between x = 1 and x = 3, and each ram is driven with the force producing that acceleration. The press has 6 identical rams. Its frame also carries 3 N from a return spring and then 10 N from a guide bracket on top of the combined ram force. What total load, in N, does the frame carry?

A cart of mass 84000 grams moves along a level rail 16 m long, and its position in metres after t seconds is s(t) = 2t^3 + 5t^2. The force producing its acceleration at t = 2 s is expressed in kN. The rail mount carries that force plus 7 kN of clamping load; a counterweight then relieves 10 kN, and a preload spring adds 2 kN. What net load, in kN, does the rail mount carry?

A sled of mass 127000 grams is accelerated along a level rail with an acceleration in m/s^2 equal to the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 11x + 24 = 0. The force producing that acceleration is expressed in kN. A rack of 10 identical sleds is driven at once; the rack frame adds 6 kN of clamping load to the combined force, and a counterweight then relieves 10 kN. What net load, in kN, does the rack frame carry?

A rocket sled of mass 153 kg runs on a level test rail. Its acceleration in m/s^2 equals the area under the curve y = 2x^2 + 6x between x = 2 and x = 4. The rail clamp carries the force producing that acceleration plus 14 N of rail friction, and this clamp load is expressed in kN. A tether adds 1 kN to each clamp load. There are 5 identical clamps under identical loads. What total load, in kN, do the 5 clamps carry?

A delivery drone of mass 50000 grams cruises at a speed in m/s equal to the area under the curve y = 5x^2 + 2x between x = 1 and x = 3. A flight is 6 identical drones, and the combined energy of motion of a flight is expressed in kJ. A depot runs 8 identical flights, and the network has 10 identical depots. What is the total energy of motion across the network, in kJ?

The figure a range officer wants, in kJ, is the combined energy of motion of 10 identical projectiles, each projectile's energy expressed in kJ. Each projectile has a mass of 22000 grams and a length of 0.5 m. The projectiles' speed in m/s is 9 times the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 11x + 28 = 0. What combined energy, in kJ, does the officer record?

A pace cart's position along a level rail, in metres, is s(t) = 4t^3 - 5t^2 with t in seconds. A sled of mass 134000 grams is given an acceleration in m/s^2 equal to the pace cart's acceleration at t = 2 s, reduced by 28. The force producing the sled's acceleration is supplied partly by a booster spring, which contributes 15 N, and partly by a tailwind, which contributes 23 N; the tow cable supplies the rest and also carries 6 N of pulley friction. What load, in N, does the tow cable carry?

A warehouse robot of mass 11000 grams moves along an aisle 40 m long at a speed in m/s equal to the largest whole number that divides both 197 and 194 exactly. Its energy of motion is expressed in kJ. An aisle holds 7 identical robots, and the warehouse has 9 identical aisles. What is the total energy of motion of all the robots, in kJ?

A container-yard tug drives trolleys of mass 185 kg and length 2.6 m along a level track. Each trolley's acceleration in m/s^2 is 3 times the largest whole number that divides both 101 and 75 exactly, and each is driven with the force producing that acceleration. A tug drives 6 identical trolleys, and the combined force per tug is expressed in kN. The yard runs 8 identical tugs. What total force, in kN, do the 8 tugs supply?

A test kart of mass 35000 grams runs at a speed in m/s equal to the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 11x + 24 = 0. Its energy of motion, less 12 J lost to wheel friction, is expressed in kJ, and the 8 kJ drawn from its battery to reach that speed is then subtracted to give the energy balance (negative meaning a net loss). What is the energy balance, in kJ?

A catapult sled of mass 48000 grams runs on a rail 30 m long. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is found by taking the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 7x + 12 = 0, multiplying by 9, and adding 1. The launch fitting carries the force producing that acceleration plus 19 N of rail friction. Express the fitting load in kN.

A drone range has 6 launch pads and counts the ways of choosing 4 of them for a sortie. The drones' speed in m/s is 4 times that count, reduced by 4. Each drone has a mass of 14000 grams. A sortie is 12 identical drones flying at that speed. What is the total energy of motion of the sortie, in J?

A rocket sled of mass 147000 grams runs on a rail 200 m long. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is 12 times the largest whole number that divides both 190 and 318 exactly, and the force producing that acceleration is expressed in kN. The rail anchor carries that force plus 18 kN of static preload plus 23 kN from the arrestor cable. What total load, in kN, does the anchor carry?

A workshop cart of mass 38000 grams is moved along a level floor with an acceleration in m/s^2 equal to the largest whole number that divides both 383 and 122 exactly. The force producing that acceleration is supplied by three sources: a ramp contributes 29 N, a tailwind fan contributes 27 N, and a hand push supplies whatever remains (a negative push means the hand must hold the cart back). Ten identical carts are moved in the same way. Express the combined hand push on the 10 carts in kN.

The figure a fleet manager wants, in kJ, is the total energy of motion of the carts in 7 identical depots, each depot running 10 identical carts, with the total expressed in kJ. Each cart has a mass of 39 kg and a length of 1.2 m. The carts' speed in m/s is 5 times the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 7x + 12 = 0. What total, in kJ, does the manager report?

A stamping-press ram of mass 196000 grams is driven along a level guide. Its acceleration in m/s^2 equals the area under the curve y = 3x^2 + 8x between x = 2 and x = 3. The force producing that acceleration is supplied partly by a return spring, which contributes 8 N, and the motor supplies the rest; the motor mount also carries 8 N of guide friction and then 19 N from a sensor bracket on top of the motor force. What total load, in N, does the motor mount carry?

A bobsled test rig launches a 47 000 g sled along an ice track. The sled's launch speed, in m/s, is numerically equal to the area under the curve y = 4x² + 0·x from x = 1 to x = 2. After launch, a pneumatic booster adds 12 J to the sled's energy of motion. The rig performs 10 launches per session, 7 sessions per day, and the test campaign lasts 6 days. What is the total energy of motion, in J, delivered across the whole campaign?
